### R

```{r}
#| label: rosenbrock-function-3d-r
#| echo: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Surface plot of the Rosenbrock function over first coordinates from -2
#|   to 2 and second coordinates from -1 to 3. The surface is a long curved
#|   valley with steep walls on both sides, floored by a narrow parabola-
#|   shaped channel along the dashed curve x2 equals x1 squared. Three marked
#|   points lie on the surface. The minimizer at (1, 1) on the valley floor
#|   is a blue circle, the origin on the valley floor is a green square, and
#|   the standard starting point (-1.2, 1) is an orange diamond, on the left
#|   wall just outside the channel.
rf_x1_sf <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = 101)
rf_x2_sf <- seq(-1, 3, length.out = 101)
rf_grid_sf <- tidyr::expand_grid(x1 = rf_x1_sf, x2 = rf_x2_sf)
rf_value_sf <- 100 * (rf_grid_sf$x2 - rf_grid_sf$x1^2)^2
rf_value_sf <- rf_value_sf + (1 - rf_grid_sf$x1)^2
rf_n2_sf <- length(rf_x2_sf)
rf_z_sf <- matrix(rf_value_sf, nrow = rf_n2_sf)
rf_p_name_sf <- c("minimizer", "origin", "start")
rf_p_x1_sf <- c(1, 0, -1.2)
rf_p_x2_sf <- c(1, 0, 1)
rf_p_color_sf <- c("#0072B2", "#009E73", "#D55E00")
rf_p_symbol_sf <- c("circle", "square", "diamond")
rf_pts_sf <- tibble::tibble(
  name = rf_p_name_sf,
  x1 = rf_p_x1_sf,
  x2 = rf_p_x2_sf,
  color = rf_p_color_sf,
  symbol = rf_p_symbol_sf
)
rf_pz_sf <- 100 * (rf_pts_sf$x2 - rf_pts_sf$x1^2)^2
rf_pts_sf$z <- rf_pz_sf + (1 - rf_pts_sf$x1)^2
rf_marker_sf <- list(color = ~color, size = 6, symbol = ~symbol)
rf_c_x1_sf <- seq(-1.7, 1.7, length.out = 200)
rf_curve_sf <- tibble::tibble(x1 = rf_c_x1_sf)
rf_curve_sf$x2 <- rf_curve_sf$x1^2
rf_curve_sf$z <- (1 - rf_curve_sf$x1)^2
rf_dash_sf <- list(color = "black", dash = "dash", width = 4)
rf_stops_sf <- c(0, 1)
rf_cols_sf <- c("#E5E5E5", "#808080")
rf_scale_sf <- list(rf_stops_sf, rf_cols_sf)
rf_eye_sf <- list(x = 1.6, y = -1.6, z = 0.9)
rf_camera_sf <- list(eye = rf_eye_sf)
rf_xaxis_sf <- list(title = "x1")
rf_yaxis_sf <- list(title = "x2")
rf_zaxis_sf <- list(title = "f(x)")
rf_scene_sf <- list(
  xaxis = rf_xaxis_sf,
  yaxis = rf_yaxis_sf,
  zaxis = rf_zaxis_sf,
  camera = rf_camera_sf
)
rf_legend_sf <- list(orientation = "h")
plotly::plot_ly() |>
  plotly::add_surface(
    x = rf_x1_sf,
    y = rf_x2_sf,
    z = rf_z_sf,
    colorscale = rf_scale_sf,
    showscale = FALSE,
    opacity = 0.7
  ) |>
  plotly::add_trace(
    data = rf_curve_sf,
    x = ~x1,
    y = ~x2,
    z = ~z,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "lines",
    line = rf_dash_sf,
    name = "valley floor"
  ) |>
  plotly::add_markers(
    data = rf_pts_sf,
    x = ~x1,
    y = ~x2,
    z = ~z,
    text = ~name,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    showlegend = FALSE,
    marker = rf_marker_sf
  ) |>
  plotly::layout(scene = rf_scene_sf, legend = rf_legend_sf)
```

### Python

```{python}
#| label: rosenbrock-function-3d-python
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Surface plot of the Rosenbrock function over first coordinates from -2
#|   to 2 and second coordinates from -1 to 3. The surface is a long curved
#|   valley with steep walls on both sides, floored by a narrow parabola-
#|   shaped channel along the dashed curve x2 equals x1 squared. Three marked
#|   points lie on the surface. The minimizer at (1, 1) on the valley floor
#|   is a blue circle, the origin on the valley floor is a green square, and
#|   the standard starting point (-1.2, 1) is an orange diamond, on the left
#|   wall just outside the channel.
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-width: 6
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

rf_x1_3d, rf_x2_3d = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(-2, 2, 101),
                                 np.linspace(-1, 3, 101))


def rf_f_3d(x1, x2):
    return 100 * (x2 - x1**2) ** 2 + (1 - x1) ** 2


rf_curve_x1_3d = np.linspace(-1.7, 1.7, 200)
rf_curve_x2_3d = rf_curve_x1_3d**2
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4.5))
ax = fig.add_subplot(projection="3d")
ax.plot_surface(rf_x1_3d, rf_x2_3d, rf_f_3d(rf_x1_3d, rf_x2_3d),
                color="grey", alpha=0.4)
ax.plot(rf_curve_x1_3d, rf_curve_x2_3d,
        rf_f_3d(rf_curve_x1_3d, rf_curve_x2_3d), "--", color="black")
rf_style_3d = {"minimizer": ("#0072B2", "o", (1, 1)),
               "origin": ("#009E73", "s", (0, 0)),
               "start": ("#D55E00", "D", (-1.2, 1))}
for name, (color, marker, p) in rf_style_3d.items():
    ax.scatter(p[0], p[1], rf_f_3d(*p), color=color, marker=marker, s=50,
               label=name)
ax.set_xlabel("x1")
ax.set_ylabel("x2")
ax.set_zlabel("f(x)")
ax.legend(loc="upper right")
plt.show();
```

:::

The [graph](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-graph) of the [Rosenbrock function](#def-rosenbrock-function),
the surface whose [level curves](vector-calculus.qmd#def-level-curve) are in @fig-rosenbrock-function,
with the curve $x_2 = x_1^2$ (dashed) along the bottom of the valley.
The [minimizer](algebra-basics.qmd#def-global-minimizer), the origin and the starting point are marked.

:::
